messages:
Maya (AE): Hey team — Zenith POC reports intermittent SSE disconnects and broken JSON in the stream. They say the client throws "Unexpected end of JSON input". Can we triage?

Priya (Support): Ticket includes a network capture: shows events arriving but sometimes a data line ends mid-JSON, then next TCP packet has remainder. Parser on their side fails because they split on blank line. Repro rate ~15% during load.

Ravi (Eng): Sounds like chunk reassembly / proxy buffering. Are they using a CDN or nginx in front of their BFF?

Maya (AE): They use Fastly in front of an AWS ALB -> nginx BFF -> app. Fastly configured for normal caching routes.

Sam (SRE): Common causes: (1) CDN/proxy coalescing or re-chunking SSE frames, (2) idle timeouts closing connection and leaving final partial packet, (3) client-side EventSource/fetch buffering.

Priya (Support): I asked them for curl -N -v output. They sent a snippet that ends with a truncated JSON line.

Ravi (Eng): Ask them to run `curl -N -v --no-buffer` and paste response headers. We need to confirm `Content-Type: text/event-stream`, `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`, and `Connection: keep-alive`. Also check for `X-Accel-Buffering` or other buffering headers.

Priya (Support): Also noted they run ALB idle timeout at default (60s). Streams usually last longer, and the app sends small deltas. Might trigger ALB close.

Maya (AE): Customer wants a fast mitigation they can apply this afternoon.

Ravi (Eng): Quick mitigations to recommend now:
- Client: implement tolerant reassembly (buffer partial data and attempt JSON parse; if fails, wait for next chunk before dropping)
- BFF/nginx: set `proxy_buffering off; proxy_set_header X-Accel-Buffering no; proxy_http_version 1.1;` on the SSE route
- CDN: configure streaming/pass-through for that endpoint (Fastly: disable response transformation and ensure `Cache-Control: no-transform`)
- App: add a lightweight heartbeat comment/data every 10-15s to avoid idle timeouts

Priya (Support): I pasted a minimal nginx config snippet in the ticket.

Ravi (Eng): Snippet to try:
```
location /stream {
  proxy_pass http://upstream;
  proxy_http_version 1.1;
  proxy_set_header Connection "";
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_cache off;
  proxy_set_header X-Accel-Buffering no;
  chunked_transfer_encoding on;
}
```

Sam (SRE): Also check ALB idle timeout vs heartbeat frequency. If ALB closes at 60s and app sends no bytes for >60s, you get abrupt close and possible partial chunk. Recommend heartbeat at 20-30s.

Priya (Support): I verified our side — deploy-bot shows model hosts stable during their failure window, no restarts recorded.

deploy-bot: model-hosts health OK at 2026-03-15T09:12:01Z; no anomalies in connection pool logs for org-zenith.

Maya (AE): I'll forward mitigations. If they flip nginx setting + add heartbeat and still see issues, we ask for tcpdump of the TCP stream and curl -N trace.

Ravi (Eng): If they can't change infra quickly, we can provide a client-side JS helper to reassemble SSE fragments and swallow transient parse errors. I can draft a tiny snippet.

Priya (Support): Action items on ticket: 1) run curl with --no-buffer -v and paste headers, 2) try client tolerant parser, 3) apply nginx snippet on BFF, 4) add heartbeat every 10-15s.

Maya (AE): Zenith will try client change today and nginx change tomorrow. I'll update here when they confirm. Thanks all. :pray:

Ravi (Eng): Keep me looped. If they provide captures I can analyze chunk boundaries.

Sam (SRE): If problems persist after those steps we'll set up a screenshare and capture pcap together.

Maya (AE): Closing thread for now, will reopen on follow-up. :rocket:
